summary:
Top 3 high-priority bugs found after Gemini's implementation of the mentor/weekly review system:
1. Mentor Review button is permanently broken for non-coordinator mentors (missing mentor_id in drilldown query)
2. Backend privilege escalation — any Admin can reassign mentors and invite faculty (bypassing coordinator-only UI guards)
3. isCoordinator undefined in demo mode + missing null guards causing PHP warnings and un-demoable features
Also lists honorable mentions: cross-classroom IDOR, inverted date acceptance, approved-log overwrite, malformed HTML id.
